data.role_evolution_summary: Each of your target roles is shifting from manual, routine tasks toward higher-level, human-centered work augmented by AI. As a Research Assistant, you'll move from performing literature searches and data entry by hand to overseeing and validating AI tools that handle those steps, freeing you for synthesis and critical evaluation. As a Student Success Peer Mentor, AI will automate mentor matching and initial student outreach, so your time can go to the complex, empathetic conversations where your relational skills shine. In People Operations, AI agents are taking over resume screening, onboarding paperwork, and compliance tracking, opening space for you to focus on data-driven process improvement, employee experience, and change management around new technology.
